subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) He was accompanied by a few merchants while going to Bagdad. (b) Bagdad was far off from his house. (c) A gang of robbers fell upon them on the way. (d) Then travelling was not easy. (e) The chief of the robbers asked Abdul Quader Jilani. "What have you got with you?" (f) At the time of departure, his mother said to him, "Never tell a lie." (g) It relates to an incident of Hazrat Abdul Quader Jilani's childhood. (h) He had to go to Bagdad to receive education.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
